title: centaurea arpensis
intro: Centaurea arpensis, commonly known as Mountain Bluet, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea arpensis include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
